# Easy Travels (Bahrain) - Document Clearance & Consular Logistics Platform

> Easy Travels is an international visa processing platform and licensed consular logistics provider based in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

## Key Services
- Electronic Visa (eVisa) processing for 100+ global destinations including Saudi Arabia, Oman, UAE, UK EVW, Schengen area, USA ESTA, and Japan.
- Client-side WebAssembly OCR for ICAO Doc 9303 compliant Machine Readable Zone (MRZ) passport and national ID card parsing.
- Real-time client document wallet for auto-saved travel clearances, official PDF visa downloads, and itinerary tracking.
- Operational administrative command center with side-by-side OCR audit drawers, multi-role access control (RBAC), and automated dual email notifications.

## Physical Headquarters & Contact

- Phone: +973 33276768

## Legal Status
Easy Travels operates as an independent private visa clearance agency assisting travelers with document preparation and submission to official government immigration portals. Easy Travels is not a diplomatic mission or government embassy.
